CustomField.description: RETIRED 29 Aug 2026: batch release no longer sends SMS at all, so nothing reads this. Was the master switch for the batch invitation SMS sent by ADHA_InvitationSmsSender when a wave is released. Off by default: this message goes to a whole cohort of real beneficiaries at once, and nothing else stops ADHA_BatchReleaseJob.run() from texting them. With it off the job releases nobody and everyone stays re-runnable. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Invitation SMS Enabled
